verdict.rationale: Navan ships AI features (Ava, Navan Edge, a hosted MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers training-data use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy for AI models. The MCP and Edge personalization items describe AI data access, not training controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
